items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or go-live; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, leave rights outreach unsent, and do not approve any go-live proposal. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics only; public terms do not confirm—and appear to restrict—commercial/public reuse, storage, derivatives, display, or alerts. All four legal launch tasks remain open. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates are also incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown; analytics is available for configured sites, and incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker for ordinary growth. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but the $4.92 and 629 aggregate clicks are unattributed; no site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal-lift claim is supported. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the four open legal tasks, preserving every unresolved item as open.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced closed. No task is closed this cycle. Current progress is limited to documented public Woot API/terms evidence, partial repository data-flow evidence, and partial privacy/cookie-page evidence. Continue the existing workstream without duplicate telemetry or external outreach.

Data-use dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data is blocked pending written rights for storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate use, and advertising; smallest next action is to attach the authoritative API agreement or permission record and field-level terms. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention, deletion/correction, processor terms, consent, and unsubscribe evidence; smallest next action is a read-only data-flow and retention table from repository/configuration evidence. GA4 is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal capture, GA4 property and sharing settings, retention, and jurisdiction review; smallest next action is a read-only consent/configuration capture without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and request workflows; smallest next action is a read-only vendor/log/incident matrix. No affiliate, advertising, retargeting, sale, or secondary monetization use is approved.

Private or gated-site decision: maintain SearchWoot's keep-private gate. Public beta and full launch remain blocked until source rights, legal data-use dispositions, security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner decisions are evidenced. The public terms page is draft-only and cannot establish upstream rights. Human counsel is required for the Woot rights/public-display issue and jurisdiction-specific privacy or monetization questions.
